info.title: Arcanist REST API
info.description: REST equivalent of the Arcanist GraphQL API (/graphql), without subscriptions. Authenticate with POST /rest/v1/auth/login and send the access token as a Bearer token.

post.summary: Creates a folder on the server, to pick it as a library location.

get.summary: Checks the ffmpeg at the given path, or which one would be found automatically.
Public description of the server. Does not require authentication.

delete.summary: Removes a location and its tracks from the catalog; files on disk are not touched. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: Folders on the server, for choosing library locations. Lists the file system roots when path is omitted. Administrators only.

post.summary: Creates a folder on the server, to pick it as a location. Administrators only.
Queues a scan, or returns the one already queued or running for the library. A full scan re-reads every file. Requires RUN_SCANS.
Moves the files of a finished organizing run back where they were, in the background. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES and a recent authentication.

put.summary: Rates a track 1–5 for the user, or clears the rating with null. With the single-star rating mode only 5 is accepted.
Stars a track for the user (rates it 5) or unstars it (clears a 5). Works with both rating modes.

get.summary: The user's tracks rated at least minRating (5 for starred ones), most recently rated first. With the single-star rating mode, only starred tracks.

post.summary: Reports that the user listened to a track. The server decides whether it counts as a play (30 seconds, and half the track or four minutes) or a skip.

get.summary: The user's counted plays, newest first.
Listening over a `period` (WEEK, MONTH, YEAR, ALL): the user's own, or another user's with VIEW_ALL_STATS. timeZone is an IANA id (UTC by default) for days and months.
What the libraries hold and how the server is listened to over a `period` (WEEK, MONTH, YEAR, ALL), per user. Requires VIEW_ALL_STATS.

put.summary: Chooses how users rate tracks: STARS (one to five) or STAR (a single star, kept as five). Nothing is lost when switching. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

get.summary: The server's other active users, to invite as playlist collaborators.
Artists, albums, tracks and playlists matching every word of the query (as word starts, ignoring accents and case), best first. first is per kind: 10 by default, at most 50.
The user's home page: recently played and added albums, mixes, most played, starred tracks, albums to rediscover or never played, and playlists. Empty sections are left out.
Mixes made for the user from their favorite artists, genres and decades, their favorites and music they never played. They change once a day.
A mix's tracks in play order. Besides the ids from mixes, any artist:<id>, genre:<id>, decade:<year> or track:<id> (a radio started from a track) works, ids without dashes.
Everything an artist page shows: top tracks, albums, albums the artist appears on, related artists and the artist's mix.

Audio of a track. Authenticate with a Bearer token or the `st` parameter of a track's streamUrl. `fileId` picks a specific copy; `download=true` sends the original as an attachment and requires DOWNLOAD. Without `format`, `maxBitRate` or `timeOffset` the original is sent with HTTP range support. `format` (see serverInfo.transcodingFormats) converts it, at `maxBitRate` kbit/s if given; `maxBitRate` alone converts to MP3 only when the original exceeds it. Converted audio has no range support: seek by requesting again with `timeOffset` in seconds. 503 transcoding_unavailable without ffmpeg.

head.summary: Audio of a track. Authenticate with a Bearer token or the `st` parameter of a track's streamUrl. `fileId` picks a specific copy; `download=true` sends the original as an attachment and requires DOWNLOAD. Without `format`, `maxBitRate` or `timeOffset` the original is sent with HTTP range support. `format` (see serverInfo.transcodingFormats) converts it, at `maxBitRate` kbit/s if given; `maxBitRate` alone converts to MP3 only when the original exceeds it. Converted audio has no range support: seek by requesting again with `timeOffset` in seconds. 503 transcoding_unavailable without ffmpeg.

get.summary: An album or track image by artworkId. `size` scales it so its longest side fits (64, 128, 256, 512 or 1024). Public and cacheable forever, so it can be used directly in image elements.
The signed-in user.
Devices where the signed-in user is currently signed in.

delete.summary: Signs out one of the signed-in user's devices.

post.summary: Changes the signed-in user's password and signs out their other devices.

get.summary: All users. Requires the MANAGE_USERS permission.

post.summary: Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

get.summary: A user by id. Requires the MANAGE_USERS permission.

put.summary: Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

put.summary: Replaces the libraries explicitly granted to a user. Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

post.summary: Sets a new password and signs the user out everywhere. Requires MANAGE_USERS and a recent authentication.

get.summary: Libraries the signed-in user can access.

post.summary: Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: A library by id. Libraries the user cannot access are reported as not found.

delete.summary: Removes the library and its tracks from the catalog; files on disk are not touched. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES and a recent authentication.

post.summary: Adds a location to a library. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: Most recent scans first, of one library or of all libraries the user can see. Requires RUN_SCANS or MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
A scan by id, including live progress while it runs. Poll it to follow a scan. Requires RUN_SCANS or MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Requires RUN_SCANS.

get.summary: Progress of the background audio analysis (loudness, fingerprints, waveforms, tempo and key). Poll it to follow progress. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

put.summary: Turns the background audio analysis on or off. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

get.summary: Where Arcanist found ffmpeg, and the progress of a download. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

put.summary: Uses the ffmpeg at the given path, or finds one automatically when null. Fails with not_ffmpeg if it does not work. Administrators only, with a recent password.

post.summary: Downloads ffmpeg (a static GPL build from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds) into the data directory in the background. Poll the status to follow it. Administrators only, with a recent password.

get.summary: Pairs of tracks whose audio is similar but not enough to merge them automatically, most similar first. `status` is OPEN (default) or DISMISSED. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Merges an open pair into keepTrackId, one of its two tracks, and returns it. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Keeps the two tracks of an open pair apart; it is not proposed again. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

put.summary: Sets the library's path template and whether files added to it are organized automatically. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: What organizing the library would move, with the given template or the library's own. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Moves the library's files to the paths its template gives them, in the background. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES and a recent authentication.

get.summary: The library's latest organizing runs, newest first. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Folders whose files are imported into libraries. Administrators only.

post.summary: Administrators only.

delete.summary: Stops importing from the folder and forgets its history; its files are not touched. Administrators only.

get.summary: Files found in drop folders, most recently changed first: in the given `status`, or else those still in a drop folder. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
How many files of the drop folders are in each state. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

post.summary: Imports a file even though it is incomplete or a duplicate (then as another copy of its track), first writing the given tags into it. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Looks at a file again, as if it had just been dropped. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Leaves a file in its drop folder; it is looked at again only if it changes. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.
Moves a file to its drop folder's trash, from which it is deleted after a while. Requires MANAGE_LIBRARIES.

get.summary: The user's playlists, those they collaborate on and public ones, most recently changed first.
A playlist by id. Playlists the user cannot see are reported as not found.

put.summary: Renames, describes and shares a playlist. Owner only.

get.summary: A playlist's tracks in order, page by page (100 by default, at most 1000).

post.summary: Adds tracks at the end or at a position. Owner and collaborators.
Makes a private playlist of the user's own with the tracks of one they can see.
Removes entries. Owner and collaborators.
Moves entries together to a position, keeping their order. Owner and collaborators.

put.summary: Replaces the users who can add, remove and reorder the playlist's tracks. Owner only.

get.summary: Installed web players; the default one is served at /. Administrators only.

post.summary: Installs (or updates) the web player in an uploaded .zip with arcanist-frontend.json at its root (form field `file`). Administrators only, with a recent authentication.
Downloads a web player's .zip and installs it (or updates it). It runs with the user's session: install only what you trust. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

put.summary: Serves this web player at /. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Removes an installed web player. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: Built-in and installed extensions, with what happened to them at startup. Administrators only.

post.summary: Installs (or updates) the extension in an uploaded .zip with arcanist-extension.json at its root (form field `file`); it runs once enabled and the server restarts. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

Downloads an extension's .zip and installs it (or updates it); it runs once enabled and the server restarts. Extensions run inside the server with full trust. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

put.summary: Switches an extension on or off. Built-in extensions and switching off apply at once; an installed one runs after a restart. Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Removes an installed extension (it stops at once and is gone after a restart). Administrators only, with a recent authentication.

get.summary: The user's app passwords, for Subsonic and mStream apps; their secrets are never shown again.

post.summary: Creates a password for one app (Subsonic, mStream) and returns its secret, only this once. Needs a recent authentication.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the user's app passwords.

get.summary: Which online services are on (MusicBrainz, AcoustID, Cover Art Archive, LRCLib) and what each has done. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

put.summary: Turns online services on or off. They send only fingerprints, identifiers and artist, album and track names. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.
Uses your own AcoustID application key instead of the project's; null or empty goes back to the project's. Requires MANAGE_SETTINGS.

get.summary: Performers and album artists with music the user can play, by name. Pages of `first` items (default 50, at most 500) after the `after` cursor.
Albums with music the user can play, by title; optionally only those of an artist.
Tracks the user can play, by title. With albumId, all of the album's tracks in disc and track order, without paging.
A track's lyrics, with synchronized lines when known. not_found when it has none.
Overview of a track's audio for seek bars, from its best copy or the given file. not_found until the copy is analyzed.
